mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of verapamil, increasing verapamil plasma concentrations and risk of cardiotoxicity; verapamil may increase valproic acid levels through protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor for enhanced verapamil effects (hypotension, bradycardia, AV block); consider verapamil dose reduction or use alternative antiarrhythmic; monitor valproic acid levels.
